name: JCR Remodeling

niche_evidence.quote: Premium Remodeling Services Luxury Kitchen Transformations Where culinary dreams meet elegant design

niche_evidence_2.quote: Premium Remodeling Services Spa-Inspired Bathrooms Your personal sanctuary awaits

niche_notes: Passed narrowly, as in the earlier wave. The one-page site has three hero slides (kitchen, bathroom, flooring) and the about text says 'specialized in flooring and remodeling'. Kitchen and bath lead the hero; flooring is the third slide. The /services/ and /service-areas/ pages are empty shells.
g4_notes: G4 passed per coordinator note (auto_signals: social_post YouTube 2026-10-02 and user-supplied google_review 2026-09-13); not re-run. No site_dated_content auto signal to validate; the default 'Hello world!' post noted earlier is not used.
g3_notes: Footer shows 'JCR Remodeling 2026' only; /credits/ returns 404; no web or marketing vendor credit on the homepage, /services/, /service-areas/ or /reviews/.

g5_evidence.quote: Founded by an immigrant determined to succeed through honest work, excellence, and a commitment

g5_notes: No franchise brand, corporate parent or location finder on the site. The service-areas text is a statewide claim ('We serve all of North, South, Central, Eastern, and Western Florida.'), not a locator.
decision_maker_notes: NONE FOUND: the site names no person. Checked homepage (about section), /services/, /service-areas/, /reviews/; /contact/, /about/, /about-us/, /privacy/, /privacy-policy/ and /terms/ all return 404.
contact_notes: No form on the site; the CONTACT US button is a tel: link and the footer offers a WhatsApp link https://wa.link/45vwks.

competitor.name: I-4 Kitchen and Bath
competitor.basis: Prior competitor_pool firm (passed mobile checks); homepage 'Address: 62 West Colonial Drive Ground Floor/Unit 101 Orlando, FL 32801', about 8 miles from JCR's 3000 Monticello Pl, Orlando 32835; viewport meta present; lists Kitchen Remodeling and Bathroom Remodeling.

assessment: Opinion: a small, three-year-old Orlando kitchen, bath and flooring firm with a thin one-page WordPress site (empty Services and Service Areas pages, no contact form, a Gmail address). It needs a real site, but there is no named owner to address.
inference_rejected: Did not treat Raphael Souza (personal LinkedIn linked in the footer) as owner: no page on the site states a name or role.
Did not treat 'JCR American Services' (name of the YouTube channel linked from the site) as a corporate parent; nothing on the site says so.
Hero line 'Luxury Kitchen Transformations' not counted as an advertised full kitchen remodel for high_ticket; no explicit full remodel, whole-home, addition or project value is stated.
Site pages created 2026-01-22 (WP API) were not counted as a trigger: a new website is not a listed trigger type, and the about text says three years in the market.
could_not_check: Owner account activity: no named owner
g6_notes: G6 passes on a published email (mailto plus visible text); decision maker null.
job_notes: WebSearch for '"JCR Remodeling" Orlando' found no listing for this firm or any posting; earlier wave also found none for JCR American Services. No careers page.
